anatomy: Headache and tiredness can occur. New severe headache, confusion, collapse or neurological changes need urgent assessment rather than attribution to tablets.
Eye pain, redness, light sensitivity or blurred vision can signal inflammation. Report promptly for eye assessment.
The electrical rhythm can change; ECG and blood chemistry checks help detect risk. Palpitations or fainting need prompt assessment.
Photosensitivity, rash and new skin cancers can occur. Protect skin and report new growths; blistering or peeling is urgent.
Blood tests check for liver injury. Yellow skin or eyes, dark urine or severe upper-abdominal discomfort need prompt review.
Kidney injury or dehydration can affect dosing. Report reduced urine or inability to keep fluids down.
Joint or muscle pain can affect daily activities. Tell the team if pain limits walking or self-care, or occurs with marked weakness.
Nausea, diarrhoea and reduced appetite can cause dehydration. Keep the agreed symptom plan and report persistent or severe symptoms.
Severe headache, dizziness, profound tiredness, thirst or altered vision can signal pituitary, adrenal, thyroid or glucose problems. Symptoms may need urgent hormone tests and treatment.
New cough, shortness of breath or chest discomfort can mean lung inflammation or infection. Report changes promptly, even with normal recent blood results.
Rare heart inflammation can cause chest pain, palpitations, faintness or breathlessness. Severe chest pain, collapse or major breathing difficulty is an emergency.
Rash and itching can occur. Rapid spreading, blistering, peeling or sores involving the mouth, eyes or genitals require urgent assessment.
Liver inflammation may first appear in blood tests. Yellow eyes or skin, dark urine, severe nausea or right-sided abdominal pain also need prompt review.
Kidney inflammation may be detected in blood tests. Report reduced urine, blood in urine, swelling or a marked change in thirst.

Fever, chills and headache can occur. At 38°C or higher, stop and call under the current product information; severe weakness, dizziness or confusion is urgent.

Sore thickened skin or redness on palms and soles can affect walking and grip. Report it early and ask for skin care tailored to your symptoms.
New blurred vision, distortion, blind spots or eye pain can reflect retinal or inflammatory problems. Contact the team promptly rather than waiting for the next cycle.
